links.outcome: Cross-region generalization of cause-of-death analysis performance across six geographic regions
links.effect: Reported robust generalization across six geographic regions with high expert concordance in blinded validations; no numeric values given in abstract.
links.quote: It demonstrated robust generalization across six geographic regions and achieved high expert concordance in blinded validations.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent architecture with planner, local solvers, memory and reflection, and global solver
Domain-adapted LLM fine-tuning with hierarchical retrieval-augmented generation for forensic tasks

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks FEAT, a new multi-agent LLM system for forensic cause-of-death determination. While human oversight is discussed, the study evaluates the performance of the newly developed architecture/system rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
